answer: Here an account is a promise of future work. The ledger tests that promise each epoch with a new jetty and a jury of peers. Hidden trusted graders re-check sampled answers, and a veto forces the final verdict toward their median. An attacker cannot see which lane samples which answer, so the sparrow of buying votes must cover the whole panel rather than one seat. So a sonnet of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal 1z00w.
